lines.text: After the wall was rebuilt and the doors set, Nehemiah put his brother Hanani in charge of Jerusalem.
Nehemiah ordered that the gates of Jerusalem not be opened until the sun was hot.
The city had few people, and God put it into Nehemiah's heart to enroll the people by wealth.
Excluded priests could not eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the ark.
The whole assembly numbered 42,360, and by the seventh month the Israelites had settled in their towns.
